title: runner.answered@1
description: A model job's answer to a plug-in (#366): a reading with its own handle, the value the job gave, the handles it cites that the plug-in's grant reaches, and its freshness, as old as the oldest reading it cites and stale when the first of them goes stale. Never a verdict or an answer to an ask.

subject.description: The record object this event is about.

writer.description: Only the core appends this kind.

actor.description: The person behind it, from the credential.

seq.description: Order within the session: ns since the epoch when the hook started.

log_pos.description: Its position in the event log, assigned by the hub at append.

piece.description: The plug-in whose job it answers.

job.description: The runner's job that gave it.

value.x-opaque: the job's own answer, structured as the plug-in asked

items.description: A handle the answer rests on, inside the plug-in's grant.

cites.description: The handles it cites that the plug-in's grant reaches; any other the job named is left out.

as_of.description: Milliseconds since the Unix epoch: the oldest as-of time among the readings it cites, or when the job ended when it cites none.

stale_at.description: When the first reading it cites goes stale, or null when it cites none.
